prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Elementor Expert Needed For Website Update
I am looking for someone to help me edit my website. It is built on Wordpress and elementor. It is about 75% of the way there and I just need someone to help me finalize some details and need help changing a few things. I need some that is experienced with elementor and has built several website using it. I need someone with a sharp eye for detail, as spacing, sizing of font, and other details like these are important to me. I would like my website to look exactly like the pictures attached. text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building and refining web applications.

I’d be glad to help finalize your WordPress + Elementor site and make it match the provided references as closely as possible. I understand the importance of the small details you mentioned—spacing, font sizing, alignment, and overall visual consistency can make the difference between something that feels “almost done” and something that looks polished and intentional. If the site is already about 75% complete, I can step in to tighten up the remaining sections, adjust layouts, and make sure the final presentation matches the pictures you attached.

While my background is primarily in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, I’m very comfortable working carefully within existing front-end structures and making precise UI updates. I also know how important it is to follow a design reference closely and keep changes consistent across the whole site.

One relevant project I completed was a serverless image pipeline for Lumen Photo Co. in the media industry. I built an upload flow where files triggered AWS Lambda to create web sizes and watermarks, then served them through a CDN using AWS S3 and CloudFront. That system processed 2.3M images and reduced hosting costs by 61%. That project required careful attention to visual output and dependable implementation, which is the same mindset I’d bring to your site updates.

I’d approach your Elementor work by reviewing the current pages section by section, comparing them to the reference images, and making targeted refinements until the spacing, sizing, and layout feel right. If needed, I can also help identify any small inconsistencies that may be making the page feel unfinished.

What are the most important sections of captureremedia.com that you want matched exactly first?
